title.en: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Designated Operating Entities) Notification 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Designated Operating Entities) Notification 2025.

2.—(1) The Authority designates each entity specified in the first column of the Schedule as a designated operating entity.
(2) The designation of an entity as a designated operating entity takes effect on the date specified for that entity in the second column of the Schedule.
